text:
Alana (PM): Quick sync — we need to lock gating for the Console Observability launch. Getting three enterprise asks that overlap: route dashboards, tracing hooks, detailed cost breakdown, and better error analytics/regression alerts. I sketched a proposed MVP and tradeoffs below. Need votes + any hidden blockers.
Alana (PM): Proposed Phase A (MVP):
- route-level dashboards (latency P50/P90, req/s, cost estimates)
- cost breakdown per-model+route (approx; not 1:1 billing)
- basic tracing hook: pass-through span-id + linkable trace in logs (no full distributed traces stored)
- error counters + regression alerting tied to prompt-set baselines

Alana (PM): Tradeoffs we should accept to hit 6w deadline: sample traces vs full retention, short (7d) retention for traces, lightweight UI templates instead of custom dashboard builder initially.

Alana (PM): Suggested launch gating metrics (pick 2-3):
- Adoption: >= 10 active routes using dashboards within 30 days
- Error-regression detection: true positive rate > 90% on sample customer checks
- Latency SLOs: P90 per-route within +/-10% of baseline after instrumentation
- Infra stability: no more than 1 P0 related to telemetry in first 2 weeks

Raj (Eng): I like Phase A shape. Question: for tracing hook, we can add `X-Span-ID` header and surface links to existing tracing backends (trace URL), avoid storing spans. That keeps infra cost down. Sampling 1% default then bump per-customer is doable.

Mei (SRE): Storage is the blocker. If we store traces/aggregates we need retention limits. 7 days for span metadata + 30d for aggregated latency histograms seems sensible. Also need rate limit on trace ingestion so noisy customers can't blow budget.

Carlos (Data): For cost breakdown we can approximate cost using token counts * model unit cost + a routing overhead multiplier. We should expose a confidence band (±%) — customers expect an explanation for discrepancies. Implementation: add `route_id` tag to all billing events and emit `model_id` with inference metadata. Minimal schema change.

Priya (CS): Two pilots (FinCorp and MedApp) explicitly need per-model cost and trace link in logs for audits. They told me that sampling is okay as long as trace links exist for any flagged error. Also want an SLA note that cost numbers may differ slightly from billing.

Tom (Design): UX approach: provide three starter dashboards (latency, cost, errors) and one-click "enable tracing" on a route page that toggles header pass-through + sampling. Keep drilldowns simple: click span-id -> open trace backend. No A/B experiments in v1.

Alana (PM): Minimal instrumentation spec (for engineering):
1) add `X-Span-ID` generation at request entry if not present and propagate to model runtime responses
2) emit a telemetry event per request with fields: `route_id`, `model_id`, `latency_ms`, `tokens_in`, `tokens_out`, `span_id`, `error_flag`
3) sampling: default 1% traces, overrides per-customer via config
4) storage: span metadata retention 7d, aggregated histograms 30d

Raj (Eng): Implementation notes: We can piggyback on existing events pipeline. Need a small schema migration (adds span_id and model_id). Will sketch PR for service + worker changes this week. Can we freeze telemetry schema for this launch?

Alana (PM): Yes freeze is preferred. If we anticipate more fields, open a follow-up PR but avoid adding new required fields now.

Mei (SRE): Also request: a safe-mode toggle that turns sampling to 0.1% if ingestion spikes and an alert when trace ingestion > X rps. ops-bot, can you add that alert template?

ops-bot: Alert created: `telemetry.trace_ingestion_rate_high` (threshold 200 req/s); responder: #eng-oncall.

Carlos (Data): One more ask — surface a cost-estimate drift metric (% difference between reported console cost and billing, sampled). Should help surface mismatches.

Priya (CS): If we can promise trace-link + cost-estimate flagging for the two pilots, they will sign for pilot access. That is time-sensitive.

Alana (PM): Proposed timeline:
- Week 0-2: schema + header passthrough + sampling plumbing
- Week 3-4: backend aggregation, histograms, cost calc prototype
- Week 5: dashboard templates + enable toggle + alerts
- Week 6: pilot rollout (FinCorp, MedApp) + validation checks

Raj (Eng): FYI: 6 weeks is tight but doable if we keep traces lightweight and reuse pipeline. I'll call out blockers in the RFC.

Mei (SRE): +1 to phase retention and safe-mode. We may need ops support during pilot rollout window.

Tom (Design): Will ship dashboard mocks by EOD Monday.

Priya (CS): Can we get a small demo for pilots in week 6? Even a short recorded walkthrough is fine.

Alana (PM): Ask: please respond with quick reaction: `+1` to accept Phase A scope, `:warning:` if you foresee an unblocker, or comment with a blocker. Planning to close scope by EOD Friday.

Raj (Eng): +1
Mei (SRE): :warning: need more clarity on ingestion quotas for noisy customers (I'll add details to RFC)
Carlos (Data): +1
Priya (CS): +1 — will coordinate pilot comms
Tom (Design): +1
ops-bot: :thumbsup:
